description: Free: returns the native coin balance and the main stablecoin balance (USDC; USDT on Tron) of one address on one chain. Use it for a quick 'does this wallet hold funds on chain X' check, before sending or after a payment. For all chains and tokens at once, use multichain_balances. Read-only. The address is sent to the hosted DevX API, which reads public RPCs at the latest block (one retry if the RPC rate-limits). No key, no payment. Returns: address, chains.<chain> with chain_id, block, rpc, native {symbol, raw, balance}, tokens [{symbol, address, raw, decimals, balance, stablecoin}], stablecoins_usd_face_value and ok, plus summary (stablecoin total at face value, chains_with_funds, chains_failed, note) and full (URL of the paid all-chains call). Balances are decimal strings. The stablecoin total is face value, not a market price.

address.description: EVM address (0x + 40 hex), Solana address (base58, 32-44 chars) or Tron address (T + 33 base58 chars).

chain.description: Chain to read; must match the address family. Default: base for a 0x address, solana for a Solana address, tron for a Tron address.

name: basic_balance
title: Free balance on one chain
